material_supports.kind: Source-derived union of material field, removed Original grain, added scoped grain; boolean full-image support at scale 1. Unrelated retained children not removed from support.
material_supports.method: Binary32 mapping/inset/mark arithmetic; field pixel centers use ceil(edge-0.5); SDL software rectangles truncate float32 origins and widths/heights with minimum 1 pixel; viewport origin (0,0) and full output clip. Old seed row*1973+column*9277 with bounded 2048-pair lattice; H1 mix seed 0xB3A02211 / 8192 pairs; P1 seed 0xB3A09C21 / 4096 pairs. Full ordered source formulas read independently before pixel comparison.

a47_counterexample.meaning: A47 source evidence, not a new screenshot or a separate test executed by A48. Does not affect the observed scale-1 gallery but prevents universal support claims.

combined_comparisons.method: Decode to uint8 RGBA; count any per-channel inequality, plus each channel individually. Retained material checks select source support, not a mask inferred from changed pixels. Outside-support observations are classified from actual full frames and painter functions.
